name: expense-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates each caller's Thunder-issued token and resolves their identity for role lookup.

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores employees (with role and manager link), expense claims, statuses, rejection reasons, and export history.

dependencies.name: receipt-storage
dependencies.description: Stores uploaded receipt files; a claim's receiptUrl points to the stored object.

dependencies.name: email-provider

config.description: API key for the chosen transactional email provider
The from-address used for status-change emails

dependencies.description: Sends the status-change email to an employee (and their manager) when a claim is approved or rejected. No provider named yet — options are SendGrid, Resend, or Postmark.

description: Ballerina service owning expense claims end to end: submission, manager approval/rejection with a reason, and finance's export of approved-but-unexported claims to a downloadable payroll-ready file. Enforces role-based access (employee/manager/finance) from the caller's Thunder-issued token, scoping each read to what that role may see. Does not integrate with any specific payroll system — export produces a file only, never a live push.
